preconditions.description: The size of the grid n is between 2 and 100.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= 3 for a in alice_colors)
postconditions.description: Alice's chosen colors are between 1 and 3.

postconditions.expression: all(b != a for a, b in zip(alice_colors, bob_colors))
postconditions.description: Bob's chosen colors are different from Alice's chosen colors.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n for i, j in bob_positions)
postconditions.description: Bob's chosen positions are within the grid.

postconditions.expression: not any((i1 == i2 and abs(j1 - j2) == 1) or (j1 == j2 and abs(i1 - i2) == 1) for (i1, j1), (i2, j2) in zip(bob_positions, bob_positions[1:]))
postconditions.description: There are no two adjacent cells with tokens of the same color.
